cli.title: CLI Download
cli.subtitle: Install the AWSome AI Gateway CLI and connect Claude Code to the corporate gateway via Cognito (OIDC) login. The first login automatically provisions your user and team.
cli.prereqDesc: Get the three values below from your administrator and export them in your shell. These are the OIDC settings issued by the Cognito User Pool.
cli.prereqEnv:
export OIDC_ISSUER_URL="https://cognito-idp.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/'<POOL_ID>'"
export OIDC_CLIENT_ID="'<COGNITO_APP_CLIENT_ID>'"
export OIDC_AUDIENCE="'<COGNITO_APP_CLIENT_ID>'"
export GATEWAY_URL="http://'<gateway-host>':8000"
export GATEWAY_ADMIN_URL="http://'<admin-api-host>':8080"
cli.installLinux:
# 1. Extract the downloaded archive
tar -xzf gateway-cli-*.tar.gz
cd gateway-cli-*/

# 2. Install (sudo required — writes managed-settings.d)
./install.sh

# 3. Cognito login (browser PKCE flow starts automatically)
gateway-cli login
#   → A browser opens with the Cognito login page
#   → On success the token is stored at ~/.gateway-cli/oidc-tokens.json (0600)
#   → On first login admin-api auto-provisions the user and team

# 4. Activate the gateway
gateway-cli setup --gateway-url "$GATEWAY_URL"

# 5. Check status
gateway-cli status

# 6. Logout / deactivate
gateway-cli logout         # deletes OIDC token + VK cache
gateway-cli disable        # removes managed-settings (sudo)
cli.installWindows:
# 1. Extract the ZIP and enter the folder

# 2. Install
.\install.ps1

# 3. Cognito login in a new PowerShell session
gateway-cli login

# 4. Activate the gateway
gateway-cli setup --gateway-url $env:GATEWAY_URL

# 5. Check status
gateway-cli status

# 6. Logout / deactivate
gateway-cli logout
gateway-cli disable
cli.cmdLogin: Browser login via the Cognito (OIDC) PKCE flow. Token stored at ~/.gateway-cli/oidc-tokens.json (0600).
cli.cmdLogout: Deletes the OIDC token + Virtual Key cache.
cli.cmdSetup: Writes the gateway config to Claude Code's managed-settings.d. Requires sudo.
cli.cmdSetupOpts: Options: --gateway-url, --admin-api-url (defaults to :8080 on the gateway-url host), --api-key-helper, --otel-endpoint
cli.cmdStatus: Shows current managed-settings state (ON/OFF + path + values).
cli.cmdDisable: Removes the managed-settings file (deactivates the gateway). Requires sudo.
cli.autoProvDesc: On the first successful gateway-cli login, admin-api automatically creates the user and team from Cognito claims.
cli.autoProvUser: User: identified by the Cognito sub claim. Email and name are synced from ID token claims.
cli.autoProvTeam: Team: a Cognito group matching Claude_<TEAM> places the user in that team. New teams are auto-created with $0 budget + HARD_BLOCK — calls are blocked until an admin sets a budget.
cli.autoProvRole: Role: matching ADMIN_EMAILS or ADMIN_GROUPS grants ADMIN, otherwise DEVELOPER.
cli.legacySts: STS-based auth (legacy): the pre-Cognito path that issued Virtual Keys directly from AWS SSO credentials is kept for compatibility. New users should use gateway-cli login (OIDC).
cli.emptyDownloads: No downloadable packages. An administrator must build with gateway-cli/package.sh and mount it into admin-api's CLI_DIST_DIR. Until then, use the source install steps above.

bodyLogging.label: Body logging (Invocation Body Logging)
bodyLogging.description: Stores complete request and response bodies in S3. They are not masked, so whatever a user put in a prompt is stored verbatim. Changes reach the gateway within a few seconds.
bodyLogging.activeWarning: Capturing — prompt and response bodies are being stored in S3 without masking.
bodyLogging.turnedOn: Body logging is on. It takes effect within a few seconds.
bodyLogging.turnedOff: Body logging is off. It takes effect within a few seconds.
bodyLogging.confirmOnMessage: From now on every request and response body is stored in S3 without masking, including anything users paste into a prompt. Turning it on is recorded in the audit log.
bodyLogging.confirmOffMessage: Request and response bodies will no longer be stored in S3. Bodies from the period it was off cannot be recovered later. You can turn it back on at any time.
